-----insert data in om tasks table
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks (TASK_NAME,DATA_LAYER,SCHEMA_NAME,TABLE_NAME,SOURCE_CODE,DESCRIPTION,UPDATE_DATETIME,CREATE_DATETIME,MONTHEND,FREQUENCY_LOADING,TABLE_TYPE,ON_DEMAND)
SELECT 'TSK_EDS_DID_BILLERS','EDS','EDS','DID_BILLERS','DID',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SCD TYPE 2','Y';GO

--DID_BILLERS
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks (TASK_NAME,DATA_LAYER,SCHEMA_NAME,TABLE_NAME,SOURCE_CODE,DESCRIPTION,UPDATE_DATETIME,CREATE_DATETIME,MONTHEND,FREQUENCY_LOADING,TABLE_TYPE,ON_DEMAND)
SELECT 'TSK_STG_EDS_DID_BILLERS','EDS_STG','D360','STG_EDS_DID_BILLERS','DID',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SCD TYPE 2','Y';GO

-----insert data in om task dependency table 
INSERT INTO om.om_task_dependency (DEPENDENCY_ID,TASK_NAME,DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,MONTHEND)
SELECT (SELECT MAX(ISNULL(DEPENDENCY_ID,0)) FROM om.om_task_dependency) + 1,'TSK_STG_EDS_DID_BILLERS','TSK_EDS_DID_BILLERS',NULL; GO


SELECT * FROM om.om_tasks WHERE TASK_NAME LIKE '%DID%'

SELECT * FROM om.om_tasks WHERE TASK_NAME IN ('TSK_STG_EDS_DID_BILLERS','TSK_EDS_DID_BILLERS')
